role: Acting Area Director, HUD Milwaukee Area Office
stance_basis: letter acknowledges receipt and states the proposal requires no comment from HUD
summary: Richard A. Kaiser, Acting Area Director of the HUD Milwaukee Area Office, sent a letter dated January 15, 1974 acknowledging receipt of the Airport Spur project materials and determining that the proposal requires no comment from HUD within its jurisdiction. He noted an attached staff comment and indicated intent to submit departmental comments, but the letter itself takes no substantive position on the project. The document preparer noted no response was necessary.
complaint_summary: Kaiser's letter acknowledges receipt of the Airport Spur EIS materials and states that the proposal requires no comment from HUD within its jurisdiction by law or expertise, while noting an attached staff comment and intent to submit departmental comments.

statement.text:
This is to acknowledge receipt of the subject material, submitted in accordance with the requirements of the National Environmental Policy Act of 1969. We have reviewed the material and have determined the following regarding our obligation to reply to your proposal within the Department of Housing and Urban Development's jurisdiction by law or expertise:
